source: existing matched Release no-U pair from C5 Part II provenance/audit; no reruns
method: decimal arithmetic on corresponding parsed decimal fields; relative = |candidate-baseline|/|baseline| only when baseline != 0; baseline-zero entries counted and not divided; no denominator floor

reported_sphere_spin_moment_xyz_muB.source: radial_ground_state_Fe_1.dat header field reported_moment_xyz_muB; exact vector copied from active-frame potential%mom0 in self.f90 before write_file

parser_evidence.method: Decimal arithmetic parses exact emitted decimal tokens, aligns rows/columns by shared row order/grid, and computes |candidate-baseline| and |candidate-baseline|/|baseline| only for nonzero baseline. For baseline zero, relative is undefined and zero-baseline counts plus maximum absolute difference are retained. No denominator floor or acceptance threshold is used.
parser_evidence.ql_mapping: Fe_out.nml and Fe_scf.nml: ql(n,l+1,spin), with l+1 ordered s,p,d. n=1 is zeroth-moment occupation q0; n=2 is the second stored moment (zero in these records); n=3 is higher radial moment q2. This corresponds to source/potential array ql(3,0:lmax,2), and the fixed-U q0/q2 accesses in source/self.f90.
parser_evidence.moment_mapping: Potential mom is the stored reference spin axis [0,0,1], not the physical moment magnitude. Physical spin/orbital moment vectors are the named records in report.out; high-precision stored orbital vector is lmom in the potential namelist. The radial snapshot also reports its integrated moment vector and norm.

dos_mapping.magneticdos.out: energy, dos_up, dos_dw, dos_mx, dos_my, dos_mz, dos_nmag (header-labelled)
dos_mapping.Fe_orbital_dos.out: energy plus 18 orbital-projected DOS fields; source writer writes energy then dosial(1:nb), fixed 5-decimal output
dos_mapping.Fe_1_spinene.out: E−Ef, cumulative spin moment components mx,my,mz from source/bands.f90
dos_mapping.Fe_orbene.out: E−Ef, cumulative orbital moment components lx,ly,lz from source/bands.f90

parser_evidence.radial_mapping: radial_ground_state_Fe_1.dat uses its explicit # columns header; all radial observable columns (rho, n, vxc, spin splitting) were compared by aligned row/column. Header fields reported_moment_xyz_muB and integrated charges/moment were separately parsed.

moment_semantics.potential_mom: Normalized/reference spin direction, not sphere spin magnitude. In bands.f90:calculate_magnetic_moments, mx/my/mz are integrated from projected spin DOS, mtot=sqrt(mx^2+my^2+mz^2)+1e-15 and mom=components/mtot; for nsp<3, mom is reset to [0,0,1].
moment_semantics.potential_lmom: Orbital angular-momentum vector (non-normalized), per potential.f90 declarations; calculated and stored by bands.f90:calculate_orbital_moments.
moment_semantics.physical_sphere_spin: mx/my/mz and mtot are physical sphere spin components/magnitude. The reported_moment_xyz_muB radial header is sourced from self.f90 magmom, which is copied from potential%mom0, populated with mx/my/mz in bands.f90, then written by radial_ground_state.f90.
moment_semantics.report_out_crosscheck: report.out reports total and per-atom spin moments at 10/6 decimal places; exact vector differences are taken from radial header.
